name: thrift-kiosk
description: Charity shop kiosk: shopper storefront + hands-free intake scanner, sharing one item database and design language.

scripts.build: npm run build -w storefront && npm run build -w scanner
scripts.typecheck: npm exec -w storefront -- tsc --noEmit && npm run typecheck -w scanner
scripts.reset-demo: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('.data',{recursive:true,force:true});console.log('Demo data reset: seed stock restored, receipts and scans cleared.')"
